### Auto Farm tab:
* Fishing Automation
    * Fishing Radar Bypass
    * Auto Fish (Automatic casting, waiting, and reeling)
    * Instant Fishing Complete
* Auto Sell
    * Auto Sell Fish

### Movement tab:
* Character Modifications
    * Movement Speed (Slider, up to 200)
    * Infinite Jump
    * No Clip
    * Water Walking
* Anti-AFK System

### Teleport tab:
* Island Locations
    * Destination Selection (Dropdown with 12+ named locations)
    * Teleport To Island
* Equipment
    * Diving Gear Toggle (Free use)
* Position Management
    * Save Current Position
    * Load Saved Position

### Shop tab:
* Purchasing
    * Purchase Fishing Rod (Dropdown with 12+ rods and prices)
    * Purchase Bait Type (Dropdown with 7+ baits and prices)

### Equipment tab:
* Fishing Rod Modifications
    * Select Fishing Rod (Dropdown)
    * Apply Maximum Stats (Sets Click Power, Resilience, Max Weight, and Base Luck to extreme values for the selected rod)
